subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat add a separate New messages indicator mode, and should that live as browser-local Control UI state rather than an openclaw.json gateway config key?
rationale: The code path is clear, but hiding or replacing the catch-up affordance changes WebChat reading behavior and the requested config shape conflicts with the retired WebChat config surface.

options.title: Browser-local indicator mode
options.body: Add a persisted Control UI/WebChat setting for indicator behavior while retaining an accessible jump-to-latest action.

options.title: No separate banner setting
options.body: Treat the existing auto-scroll modes as sufficient and keep New messages as the mandatory manual catch-up affordance.

options.title: Gateway config surface
options.body: Reopen a documented WebChat config key with schema and doctor implications if maintainers want operator-level policy rather than per-browser preference.

recommendation.title: Browser-local indicator mode
recommendation.body: Add a persisted Control UI/WebChat setting for indicator behavior while retaining an accessible jump-to-latest action.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the adjacent auto-scroll selector and already separated this issue from that merged work in the live discussion.
